scope.manifest_record_scope: Manifest records and source_records explicitly present in the listed local manifests.
scope.matching_policy: Only exact manifest scope.package, scope.source_path, or record locator/local path under the pack path establishes a match.
scope.no_semantic_matching: COURSE.yaml fonti, course names, titles, document topics, and text similarity are never used for matching.
excluded_payloads: COURSE.yaml source text beyond the observed fonti-field presence
PDF, XML, HTML, source text, exam questions, answers, and solutions
live URL requests or current license/legal verification
scope.state_policy: The audit emits only observed_local or blocked; missing or insufficient evidence is never promoted.
